objective: Pointer users need immediate, restrained confirmation that a photography-led quest card opens a real quest detail surface.
spatial_relationship: The card lifts two pixels toward the pointer while its photograph moves only 1.5 percent closer within the fixed crop.

selection_rationale.escalation_reason: Tier zero would remove a useful click-affordance cue; the known two-state values require only CSS.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Photography-led cards otherwise have little pointer-specific affordance beyond the cursor.

timing.derivation: Hover is frequent and travel is two pixels or less, so the interaction uses the approved fast token and stays below the brand's larger 220 millisecond card ceiling.

easing.character: Responsive and grounded, with no spring or game-like bounce.

interruption.notes: CSS transitions naturally reverse when the pointer leaves mid-flight.

responsive.mobile: No hover motion; tap feedback is the browser-visible active state without travel.
responsive.tablet: Runs only when the primary pointer reports hover capability.
responsive.desktop: Two-pixel lift and 1.015 image scale on hover-capable pointers only.
responsive.orientation_or_input_notes: The effect never runs for touch or keyboard activation.

reduced_motion.implementation: Hover transitions are defined only inside both prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and hover:hover media queries.
reduced_motion.vestibular_review: Tiny local movement only; no large-area zoom or peripheral loop.

keyboard_and_focus.focus_behavior: Keyboard focus uses an immediate three-pixel focus ring and never applies the hover transform.

ssr.initial_state: Static card at its resting transform.

performance_budget.cls_contribution: None; transform does not alter card layout.
performance_budget.inp_notes: Navigation is immediate and never awaits motion.

acceptance_criteria: Hover feedback completes in 140 milliseconds and reverses cleanly.
Touch and keyboard activation do not trigger movement.
Reduced-motion mode leaves the card static and fully actionable.
The effect causes no layout shift or overflow.
